title: Export chats · 0.5.3
description: Share a whole chat as a Markdown file, in the same format as the web.
notes: Touch and hold a chat and choose Export as Markdown to share or save the whole conversation as a .md file.
Exports match the web: each reply says which model wrote it, attachments are listed and unfinished replies are marked.
Each reply still has its own Share button for sharing one answer.
